Privacy Policy

Human Atlas is built to be explored, not to watch you. We don't collect, store or sell your personal information.

Effective date: September 27, 2026

Summary

  • No account is needed, and we never ask for your name, email or other personal details.
  • No analytics, advertising or tracking. We don't use cookies, advertising identifiers or third-party tracking tools.
  • Nothing you do in the app is sent to us. The structures you view, search or select stay on your device.

Information we collect

Human Atlas does not collect any personal information. The app downloads anatomy models and interface files so it can display them. These are the same for every user and contain no information about you.

Hosting and fonts

App content is served by our hosting provider, Vercel, and the interface typefaces are loaded from Google Fonts. As with any internet request, these providers may receive technical information such as your IP address, device type and browser version, and may keep it in short-term server logs for security and performance. We do not use this information to identify you. See the Vercel Privacy Policy and Google Privacy Policy for details.

Emails you send us

If you contact support, we receive your email address and whatever you include in your message. We use it only to reply to you, and we don't share it or add you to any mailing list.

Children's privacy

Human Atlas is suitable for students of all ages. Because we don't collect personal information from anyone, we don't knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 (or the equivalent age in your region).

Your rights

Because we don't hold personal data about you, there's usually nothing to access, correct or delete. If you've emailed us and want that correspondence deleted, just ask and we'll remove it.

Changes to this policy

If we change how Human Atlas handles information, we'll update this page and the effective date above.
